Silksong damage calculator: hits to kill every boss

In Silksong each enemy takes different damage depending on the level of what hits it: so hits to kill it is a question per enemy. Pick one of the wiki's 262, or one of the 49 enemy gauntlets, and the site gives you each of your attacks' damage against it, how many it takes and the quickest way through, with your Tools and your silk. And the other way: how many hits of each of its attacks kill you.

Questions

Why does the same slash deal different damage to each enemy?

Because each enemy carries five modifiers, one per Needle or Kit level: the early ones take more from an upgraded Needle. Damage is weapon × the enemy's modifier × (1 + your modifiers), rounded half to even.

Is it free? Do I need an account?

Free, no account and no ads. Your save never leaves your browser: it's read there and kept there.
